_comment: The full RQ3 matrix for the guided run: python -m rig session --guided --port COMx --config configs/rq3_guided.json. Angles run in ascending order and, at each distance, the higher angles are skipped once the worst A+B over solo ambient ratio (both zones, both sensors) is at or below adaptive_stop_ratio. expected_range_mm is the 16x16 range each sensor reads at that distance on the local rig (0.3 m and 0.8 m from the dark grey board, tape to the sensor window): measure your own with python tools/live_ranges.py and replace these. Tolerances are in mm.
name: rq3-guided
